title: sheynkmanlab/lrp2 pipeline parameters
description: Long-read proteogenomics pipeline for PacBio Iso-Seq data

input_output_options.title: Input/Output Options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.
input.help_text: You will need to create a design file with information about the sample files. Required columns: 'sample_name', 'sample_path', 'condition', 'sample_type'. Each RNA sample must have a unique 'sample_name' value, which will be used to label count matrix columns. Protein samples with matching 'sample_name' and 'condition' will be grouped together for proteomics analysis.

dataset_name.help_text: This name will be used as a prefix for all output files. It should be a descriptive name for your project or experiment.

outdir.description: Folder for the results, relative to the job results. Leave as results unless you need another name.

reference_genome_options.title: Genome Reference Options
reference_genome_options.description: Reference genome related files and options required for the workflow.

genome.description: Name of genome reference. This automatically populates the paths for the reference FASTA and GTF files if using GENCODE references.
genome.help_text: Use this parameter to specify a GENCODE reference by ID, which builds the full paths for the reference FASTA, GTF, and protein FASTA, e.g. `--genome GRCh38.p14.v50`. Available IDs are defined in `conf/gencode_references.config`. Defaults to `GRCh38.p14.v50` if not specified. For custom references, please contact us.

local_reference_gtf.description: Path to local reference GTF file (advanced users only, do not use with --genome).
local_reference_gtf.help_text: Advanced parameter for custom references. Must be used with --local_reference_fasta and --species. Cannot be used with --genome. For custom reference support, please contact us.

local_reference_fasta.description: Path to local reference FASTA file (advanced users only, do not use with --genome).
local_reference_fasta.help_text: Advanced parameter for custom references. Must be used with --local_reference_gtf and --species. Cannot be used with --genome. For custom reference support, please contact us.

isoseq_collapse_options.title: S1 PacBio IsoCall Options
isoseq_collapse_options.description: Options for the PacBio IsoCall transcript calling module.

s1_alignment_threads.description: Number of alignment threads for pbmm2 (-j parameter).
s1_alignment_threads.help_text: Specifies the number of threads for alignment in pbmm2. If not specified, defaults to 75% of available CPUs allocated to the process.

s1_alignment_sorting_threads.description: Number of sorting threads for pbmm2 (-J parameter).
s1_alignment_sorting_threads.help_text: Specifies the number of threads for BAM sorting in pbmm2. If not specified, defaults to 25% of available CPUs allocated to the process.

sqanti_transcript_options.title: S2 Transcriptome Options
sqanti_transcript_options.description: Options for the SQANTI3 QC and filtering modules.

protein_coding_filter.description: Filter to keep only protein-coding genes.

internal_priming_filter.description: Filter to remove internal priming artifacts.

template_switching_filter.description: Filter to remove template switching artifacts.

percent_polya_threshold.description: Threshold for polyA percentage downstream of TTS.

transcript_class_keep.description: Comma-separated transcript structural categories to retain (FSM, ISM, NIC, NNC, or 'ALL').

predicted_proteome_options.title: S3 Predicted Proteome Options
predicted_proteome_options.description: Options for CPAT ORF calling and protein classification.

species.description: Species for CPAT model selection (human or mouse).

cpat_coding_threshold.help_text: Coding probability threshold for CPAT. Auto-set based on species if not specified (human=0.364, mouse=0.44).

top_orf.description: Number of top ORFs to retain per transcript.

protein_class_keep.description: Comma-separated list of protein classifications to keep.
protein_class_keep.help_text: Protein classification categories to retain (e.g., FPM,IPM,NPC,NPE).

min_junctions_after_stop_codon.description: Minimum number of junctions after stop codon for filtering.

differential_analysis_options.title: S4 Multisample Analysis Options
differential_analysis_options.description: Options for multi-sample differential expression and splicing analysis.

min_samples_per_intron.description: Minimum number of samples per intron for leafcutter differential splicing.

min_samples_per_group.description: Minimum number of samples per group for leafcutter differential splicing.

min_usage_ratio.description: Minimum junction usage ratio for minicutter filtering.

leafcutter_threads.description: Number of threads for leafcutter differential splicing.
leafcutter_threads.help_text: Specify the number of threads to use for leafcutter differential splicing analysis. If not specified, defaults to using the number of CPUs allocated to the process (12 for process_high).

drimseq_min_gene_expr.description: Minimum gene-level expression for DRIMSeq filtering.
drimseq_min_gene_expr.help_text: Genes with total counts below this threshold will be filtered out before differential usage analysis.

drimseq_min_isoform_prop.description: Minimum isoform/feature proportion for DRIMSeq filtering.
drimseq_min_isoform_prop.help_text: Isoforms/features with proportion below this threshold will be filtered out before differential usage analysis.

skip_isocall_inputs.title: Skip IsoCall Mode (Non-PacBio Data)
skip_isocall_inputs.description: Parameters for providing external isoform calls (e.g., from ONT data) to skip the PACBIO_ISOCALL subworkflow.
skip_isocall_inputs.help_text: Use these parameters to provide pre-computed isoform GTF and count matrix from external sources (e.g., ONT with StringTie, Bambu, FLAMES, etc.). When both S2_custom_gtf and S2_custom_counts are provided, the pipeline will skip PACBIO_ISOCALL and start from the TRANSCRIPTOME subworkflow. The --input samplesheet parameter is still required as it contains metadata needed for downstream analysis.

S2_custom_gtf.description: Pre-computed GTF file with called isoforms (from any isoform caller).
S2_custom_gtf.help_text: Path to a GTF file containing called transcript isoforms from any long-read isoform caller (e.g., PacBio IsoCall, ONT Bambu, ONT FLAMES, StringTie, etc.). Can be gzipped (.gtf.gz) or uncompressed (.gtf). Transcript IDs should follow the format: ENSEMBL_ID for annotated transcripts, or ENSEMBL_ID.{suffix} for novel transcripts.

S2_custom_counts.description: Pre-computed count matrix (transcript counts per sample).
S2_custom_counts.help_text: Path to a count matrix file with transcript IDs in the first column and sample counts in subsequent columns. Sample column names must match the 'sample_name' values in your samplesheet. Supports CSV or TSV format.

multisample_only_inputs.title: Multisample Analysis Only Mode
multisample_only_inputs.description: Parameters for running only multisample analysis with pre-computed inputs from a previous LRP2 run.
multisample_only_inputs.help_text: Use these parameters to re-run only the multisample analysis subworkflow using outputs from a previous full pipeline run. All four file parameters must be provided together to enable this mode. The --input samplesheet parameter is not required in this mode.

S4_custom_gtf.description: Pre-computed filtered GTF file from TRANSCRIPTOME subworkflow.
S4_custom_gtf.help_text: Path to the filtered GTF file (typically named *_corrected_filtered.gtf) from a previous LRP2 run. This file is output by the FILTER_TRANSCRIPTOME module in the TRANSCRIPTOME subworkflow.

S4_custom_counts.description: Pre-computed transcript count matrix from TRANSCRIPTOME subworkflow.
S4_custom_counts.help_text: Path to the transcript count matrix file (typically named *_hashids_with_cpm_filtered.txt) from a previous LRP2 run. This file contains CPM-normalized transcript counts.

S4_custom_orf_counts.description: Pre-computed ORF count matrix from PREDICTED_PROTEOME subworkflow.
S4_custom_orf_counts.help_text: Path to the ORF count matrix file (typically named *.predicted.proteome.high_confidence_ORF_cpm.txt) from a previous LRP2 run. This file contains CPM-normalized ORF counts.

S4_multisample_metadata.description: RNA sample metadata CSV file for multisample analysis.
S4_multisample_metadata.help_text: Path to a CSV file with RNA sample metadata. Accepts two formats: (1) Simplified format with columns 'name', 'sample_path', 'group', 'sample_type', or (2) Standard samplesheet format with columns 'sample_name', 'sample_path', 'condition', 'sample_type', 'mass_spec_type'. The pipeline auto-detects which format you're using. You can use the auto-generated *_rna_samples_metadata.csv file from a previous LRP2 run, your original samplesheet (if RNA-only), or a custom metadata file in either format.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

container_images.title: Container images
container_images.description: Images built from container/ and tagged by commit SHA.

image_registry.description: Registry and repository the images are pulled from.

image_tag.description: Commit SHA of the image build to use. Never latest.
